cpu_accounting_before_launch.prior_charge_kind: Conservative preflight reserve, not a measured CPU result
cpu_accounting_before_launch.scope: Preparation10s plus separately registered prior observation charge, absolute current parent SELF and all reaped CHILDREN including memory_pressure, ps, failed preexec children and workers, plus batch tail0.2s. Live worker CPU separately sampled. No child or observation CPU is added twice. A missing prior ledger makes the full total unknown, not zero.
